profile.headline: I like making things
profile.summary: My goal is to combine the knowledge and experience in Electrical Engineering with my passion for music to further the audio technology field and make art a more accessible experience for all.

company.name: Avigilon Alta, formerly Openpath Security Inc.

positions.title: Application / Product Development Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed dev boards for the IC's that we manufactured: DSPs, ADC/DACs, transceivers, etc..., as well as provided support to customers as they developed internally with these boards
•	Supported customers as they designed our IC's into their products including schematic/layout validation and firmware level algorithm design in both Assembly and C/C++
•	Designed and developed prototypes for new IC's to determine optimal market application.

positions.title: Signal Processing Group Co-op
positions.description:
•	Developed software tools in MATLAB and CSR Assembly for tuning headset processing blocks on the CSR8670 chip
•	Wrote embedded CSR Assembly code to efficiently format and store values for 100’s of tuning parameters on the limited memory of the 8670
•	Worked in MATLAB and Python to determine optimal tuning parameters for various signal processing algorithms (AEC, AGC, EQ, Beamformers, Noise Suppression) 
•	Developed testing model to quantitatively compare speech recognition performance between headsets using Google’s Speech Recognition API

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
•	Coded and maintained security tests in C and Python to find vulnerabilities in firmware images
•	Created automated scripts in Python to stress test server functionality that are part of a global company-wide repo and still in use today

certifications.name: Amateur Radio Operator Class License, General
certifications.title: Amateur Radio Operator Class License, General
